slots.writingObjective: State as a fact about TextOS that reading cited sources is a separate, bounded step that reads robots.txt first.
One sentence for a search result: TextOS reads cited pages in a bounded, resumable step, checks robots.txt first, stays on the public web, and only proposes passages.
Open on the reader's concern — a tool that pulls text from other people's pages to write about their brand — and say that TextOS treats reading a source as its own governed step.
slots.buyerIntent: What does the tool do on other people's sites?

slots.heading: What should a content tool do when it reads the pages it cites?
slots.writingObjective: Answer directly: reading happens in a dedicated step outside writing, within a budget, one request at a time per site, robots.txt first, and every refused access recorded with its reason.

slots.heading: Reading is its own step, with a budget
slots.writingObjective: Explain the dedicated step: a request and time budget, one request at a time per origin, the same request not repeated, resumable and cancellable, and freshness shown without a false promise.
slots.buyerIntent: Will it hammer a site or run forever?

slots.writingObjective: Caption the figure of this note in one factual sentence, grounded in the evidence it cites.

slots.heading: Asking first, and saying why a page was not read
slots.writingObjective: Explain robots.txt read first, refusals recorded in an append-only log with their reason (forbidden, disallowed, undetermined, not found, redirect off site, network faults), and the same discipline in the site crawler: read-only, same origin, bounded, no script execution, 'not available' never turned into 'absent'.
slots.buyerIntent: What happens when a site says no?

slots.heading: Staying on the public web
slots.writingObjective: Explain that connections refuse any non-public address and reuse the verified address, that a cited source may follow its www alias on the same port and never downgrade from https to http, while the site crawl stays on the same origin.
slots.buyerIntent: Could it be tricked into reading private systems?

slots.heading: A passage proposed is not a fact accepted
slots.writingObjective: Explain that each page read proposes at most three passages with a demonstrated occurrence and proposed types, subject and risks, that identical passages from two sources keep two provenances, and that nothing is approved or offered to the writer until a person qualifies it.
slots.buyerIntent: Does reading a page make it a fact?

slots.heading: What to ask any AI writing vendor
slots.writingObjective: Give the buyer a short list of questions to put to any vendor, one per sentence, drawn from the mechanisms this note describes. Recommendations only, no claim about TextOS.

slots.heading: Where to go next
slots.writingObjective: Point the reader to the related notes. No claim about TextOS.
